subject: SELF and SUPER
notes: Rule (--check 8.4.3.8.4 'both reference the object that was used to invoke the method' -> OK §8.4.3.8.4 1)). SELF renders `this.M()` and SUPER `base.M()` (InvokeForm.Self/Super) on the SAME C# receiver `this`, so both reference the invoking object. Probe probe/self-and-super/PGR3.cob (A.M does INVOKE SELF "N"; C.M does INVOKE SUPER "M"; object of class C) prints C.M / A.M / C.N / B.N at --std 2002: the SUPER-invoked base body's SELF is still the C object. conformance:cases/_unassigned/oo_self covers the SELF half (shared per-instance N) only; the SUPER half is probe-verified, so no single spec-derived test closes both halves - test-ref left empty.
